body: KaiCenat had the internet laughing after trolling Reggie on stream following accusations that Kai was allegedly messing with other streamers’ Wi-Fi to get an advantage and pull more viewers to his own streams. Reggie seemingly believes Kai is doing whatever it takes to make sure his stream gets the most attention, but Kai’s response has everybody watching to see how far this back-and-forth is going to go Was Kai wrong for this? clips.
